question: Does a per-chain statistic derived from telemetry the default run already records -- the retained refined-leaf rate (fraction of built leaves accepted above refinement level 0) and/or the end-of-warmup step collapse -- separate silent-funnel runs from clean runs well enough to ship as an observe-only warning alongside WP44's ChainWarning?
change_under_test: None during the evidence run: the sampler and the library are untouched (worktree base 3924b090). The statistics are computed from WorkTotals (RunTelemetry::retained()), RunTelemetry::warmup_end() and Posterior::chain_warnings(). An observe-only ChainWarning variant is implemented only if the decision rule passes.

posteriordb.note: read-only reference to the WP46 checkout; reference draws are read from it, nothing is written

compiled_models: BridgeStan 2.9.0 libraries (no STAN_THREADS) copied from sibling builds of the same source: the 15 house models from C:/dev/owalnuts-wt/dense-metric/STUDIES/dense_metric_posteriordb_v1/models/, seeds_centered and radon hierarchical_intercept_centered from C:/dev/owalnuts-wt/posteriordb-breadth/STUDIES/posteriordb_breadth_v1/models/
sampler: owalnuts::sampler defaults exactly (Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default(), Init::uniform() starts for posteriordb models, Limits::admit_worst_case(), DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = None), the WP44 cell verbatim; the funnel uses the house starts omega in {-3, -1, 1, 3} (posteriordb_bench_v6/src/bin/funnel.rs) at 1,000/1,000
seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over this worktree and the main checkout, and grep -w over every sibling worktree's STUDIES/*/protocol.json and PREREGISTRATION.md: no use of 731401-731403 or 731410-731413.
negatives_source: the 13 house models with owalnuts-da 3/3 in STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v6/artifacts/summary.json per_model (eight_schools_noncentered is also 3/3 there and is listed last as the task's named extra negative); excluded: eight_schools_centered (0/3, a positive), mcycle_gp-accel_gp (1/3), sblrc-blr (2/3)
run_order: positives in listed order then negatives in listed order; seeds ascending within a model; strictly sequential; each cell launched exactly once (create-new launch marker); a failed cell is a result

references.posteriordb_models: every negative and eight_schools_centered: posteriordb reference draws (eight_schools_centered via its reference_posterior_name, as in v6/WP44)
references.funnel10: exact: E[omega] = 0, E[x_i] = 0 (i = 1..9), P(omega < -5) = 0.0477903522728147; z = (estimate - exact) / ArviZ MCSE of the mean (of the indicator for the tail mass)
references.rejected_reference: if a reference fails acceptance, that model's cells are judged on the gates only, and this is reported

seeds.note: non-centred rewrite c = sigma * c_raw, c_raw ~ normal(0,1); identical posterior over the centred model's parameters and transformed parameter b

radon.note: posteriordb radon_hierarchical_intercept_noncentered, identical posterior over (alpha, beta, mu_alpha, sigma_alpha, sigma_y)

estimators: ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05/0.95), mean MCSE on the reference parameters (BridgeStan constrained, transformed parameters included; funnel: the 10 coordinates); z = (mean - ref mean) / sqrt(MCSE^2 + ref MCSE^2) as WP44/v6

truth.wrong_cell: any house gate fails OR max |z| over reference parameters (and, for the funnel, the tail mass) > 3
truth.positive_cell: a cell of a positives-list model that is wrong_cell
truth.negative_cell: a cell of a negatives-list model that is NOT wrong_cell
truth.off_diagonal: positives-list cells that are clean and negatives-list cells that are wrong are reported but excluded from the primary confusion matrix
truth.process_errors: cells without draws (sampler error, timeout, crash) are wrong_cell for reporting but excluded from every confusion matrix

statistics_per_chain.refined_leaf_rate: R = (leaves_built - refinement_level_built[0]) / leaves_built over the retained partition (RunTelemetry::retained())
statistics_per_chain.mean_refinement_depth: sum_l l * refinement_level_built[l] / leaves_built over the retained partition; also reported conditional on l > 0
statistics_per_chain.step_collapse_factor: S = (median over the cell's chains of the end-of-warmup step) / (the chain's end-of-warmup step)
statistics_per_chain.also_recorded: retained and warmup divergences, retained depth-cap stops, refinement exhaustions, WP44 Posterior::chain_warnings() by check and chain

thresholds.rule: a priori, computed once after all cells: T_R = 3 x the median of R over every chain of every process-valid negatives-list cell (14 models x 3 seeds x 4 chains); T_S = 3 x the median of S over the same chains. A chain fires when its statistic is strictly greater than the threshold; a cell fires when any chain fires. If the pooled median is 0, the threshold is 0 and any positive value fires.
thresholds.post_hoc: any other threshold (ROC sweep, optimal cut) is reported as post hoc and is not evidence

decision.cell_level: sensitivity = fired / positive cells >= 0.75 AND specificity = not fired / negative cells >= 13/14 (0.92857)
decision.model_level: a model fires when >= 2 of its 3 cells fire; a positives-list model is in the denominator when >= 2 of its cells are wrong, a negatives-list model when >= 2 are clean; sensitivity >= 0.75 AND specificity >= 13/14
decision.minimum_positives: if fewer than 6 positive cells exist, the rule is reported as not met for lack of positives
decision.rule: ship the first candidate in order that meets BOTH the cell-level and the model-level criteria as an observe-only ChainWarning variant with the threshold frozen at its a-priori value; otherwise ship nothing and document the negative

predictions.P1: refined-leaf rate on positives >= 3x the median over negatives: the pooled median of R over positives-list chains >= T_R (task prediction)
predictions.P1b: the same per positive model: each positive model's median chain R >= T_R (task prediction, per-model reading)
predictions.P2: C_R at T_R: cell-level sensitivity >= 0.75 and specificity >= 13/14, and model-level likewise (task prediction; equals the decision rule for C_R)
predictions.P3: WP44's warnings alone (any ChainWarning in the cell) fire on <= 2 of the 4 positive models (model-level, >= 2 of 3 seeds; all four positives-list models in the denominator) (task prediction)
predictions.P4_agent_forecast: the agent's own forecast from WP34 (refinement_role_v1, da arm: refined fraction 0.0093 on eight_schools_noncentered, 0.0108 on one_comp, 0.0051 on garch11, against a 14-model median near 0.002) and WP46 (seeds_centered stuck chains at 0.04, other chains 0.0001-0.008): C_R cell-level specificity < 13/14 and the decision rule fails; the stuck seeds_centered chain is the highest-R chain of its cell on >= 2 of 3 seeds
predictions.P5_agent_forecast: C_S (cross-chain step collapse) fires on the funnel but not on seeds_centered (WP46: equal steps across chains on seeds_centered)
